name: Split Band
tagline: Cream-over-white before/after split: mono labels, big bold statements, one orange text selection.
whenToUse: Spine C listicles where each item replaces an old habit (Flip + proof per item)
Opinionated 'how AI changed this job' takes (pure flips, logged as a deviation)
Not for diagrams, head-to-heads (S03) or system builds

fonts.statement: Inter 650, opsz 32 (Google Fonts variable Inter) — statements, cover headlines, deliverable, byline
fonts.label: JetBrains Mono 400 — labels, count line, command chip, counter

palette.selection: #F8CFA8 apricot, multiply; bars + dots #D9551F; selected text #3A1808

fitPass.statements: 126 px on a 115 px line, both statements share one size, shrink in 2 px steps to the 96 px floor until each fits 908 px and its line budget (3; 1 for proof/twin after; 2 with a chip)
fitPass.cover: 130 px headlines, shrink to 96 px until every line and selection box fits 908 px
fitPass.deliverable: 74 px on 84 px, floor 56 px, <= 2 lines
fitPass.copyLimits: label <= 20 chars, statement <= 7 words, proof after <= 15 chars, cover subject/phrases <= 13, count line <= 30, CTA before <= 6 words, keyword <= 10, deliverable lines <= 24, command <= 34
fitPass.onFailure: a red FIT/COPY banner across the top of the slide (visible in the export on purpose) + console.error + window.fitReport

files.slides.html: copy to carousel root, edit DECK labels + slides[] at bottom
files.preview.png: cover + Flip + proof rendered from this file's sample slides
